verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a native URI protocol for triggering actions like opening or creating notes, which directly supports scripting/automation via deep links (obsidian-docs-8). However, there is no first-party local HTTP endpoint or official CLI evidenced — the probe explicitly confirms Obsidian ships no official CLI or vendor MCP server, leaving any local-endpoint automation to third-party community plugins not covered in this pack. Missing for 10: vendor-documented local REST/HTTP endpoint, independent hands-on examples of URI-driven workflows in real automation pipelines.
